title: Building a Cleaner, Greener L.A. | 8th Annual Beautification Conference
description:
Los Angeles residents, community groups, and City leaders came together at Griffith Park’s Friendship Auditorium for the 8th Annual Beautification Conference.

Organized by the Board of Public Works and the Office of Community Beautification, in partnership with Keep Los Angeles Beautiful, the event connected Angelenos with resources, workshops, and ideas to help create cleaner, greener, and more beautiful neighborhoods.

Residents can also help keep L.A. clean by reporting graffiti, illegal dumping, trash, and other service needs through the MyLA311 app or by calling 3-1-1.

Want to organize a neighborhood cleanup? The Office of Community Beautification can help coordinate volunteer efforts and provide access to cleanup tools and supplies.

Learn more about how Angelenos are working together to beautify Los Angeles communities.
